app.name: LastHelp
app.tagline: Report a problem or suggest an improvement. No account required.
appearance.lead: These settings apply to your account only.
attention.diskWhy: Only {free} of {total} left. The database, and the copy made before each update, need room.
attention.diskAct: Free some space on the server.
attention.proxy: A proxy is in front and was not declared
attention.proxyWhy: Every visitor gets the proxy's address: in the sessions and in the sign-in limits.
attention.restartAct: Set it in the configuration and restart LastHelp.
attention.publicUrlWhy: Issues opened on the forge carry no link back to the report.
attention.httpsWhy: Session cookies are not marked secure, and passkeys only work over HTTPS.
attention.httpsAct: Serve it behind a proxy with HTTPS.
auth.passwordHelp: At least 10 characters. A passphrase is recommended.
backups.confirmRestore: Restore {file}? All data written since it was created will be replaced.
backups.help: Consistent snapshot of the running database. Store it on another machine.
backups.lead: A single file with accounts, reports, votes, replies and settings.
backups.restoreHelp: Replaces all current data with the contents of the file.
backups.restoreWarning: Reports created after the backup will be lost. This cannot be undone.
backups.restored: Restored. The previous database was kept as {kept}. Restart the server to apply it.
error.accepts_nothing: A project must accept at least one report type.
error.already_set_up: This installation is already set up.
error.bad_layout: Invalid page layout. No changes were made.
error.board_closed: Daily limit reached for this project. Try again later.
error.cannot_delete_self: You cannot delete your own account.
error.channel_bad_url: The address must start with http:// or https://.
error.channel_denied: The service refused the token. Check it and send the test again.
error.channel_no_relay: This server has no mail relay configured, so email cannot be sent.
error.channel_not_found: The service answered that this address does not exist. Check the topic or path.
error.channel_offline: This installation is set to work offline, so it sends nothing out.
error.channel_rejected: The service received the message and refused it.
error.channel_server_unset: The server has no channel set yet. An administrator sets it under Notifications.
error.channel_unreachable: The service could not be reached. Check the address and that this server can connect out.
error.conversation_closed: This report is closed, so it takes no more comments.
error.csrf: Security token missing or expired. Reload the page.
error.different_repository: Both reports must be in the same project.
error.form_stale: Form expired. Reload the page and submit again.
error.image_unreadable: Unsupported image format. Use PNG or JPEG.
error.images_full: There is no more room for images on this server. Tell its administrator.
error.images_off: This project does not accept images.
error.invalid_address: Invalid address. Use lowercase letters, digits and hyphens.
error.invalid_email: Enter one valid email address, with no name or list around it.
error.word_too_long: A word on the list is too long.
error.word_chars: A word cannot contain a comma or control characters.
error.words_too_many: There are too many words on the list.
error.kind_not_accepted: This project does not accept this report type.
error.question_invalid: The question needs a name, and a list at least one choice.
error.question_limit: A project can ask up to 10 questions of its own.
error.field_invalid: One of the answers is not valid.
error.last_administrator: This is the only administrator. Assign another one first.
error.no_forge: No forge connected to this organization.
error.not_a_backup: Not a LastHelp backup compatible with this version.
error.push_endpoint_refused: This browser's push service is not one LastHelp can send to.
error.push_no_devices: None of your devices is subscribed yet. Turn notifications on in your profile first.
error.push_not_delivered: The push service did not accept the message. Try again in a moment.
error.push_too_many_devices: You already have 20 devices. Remove one first.
error.password_too_short: Password must be at least 10 characters.
error.rejected: This project does not accept this report type.
error.too_many: Too many requests. Try again in a moment.
error.code_wrong: That code is not right. Check the time on your phone and try again.
error.sign_in_expired: That took too long. Sign in again.
error.two_step_not_set_up: Start setting up two-step sign-in again.
error.passkey_unavailable: Passkeys need this page to be opened over https with its name, not an IP address.
error.passkey_refused: That passkey could not sign in.
error.passkey_expired: That took too long. Try again.
error.unknown_status: Invalid status for this report type.
error.update_bad_checksum: The download does not match the signed checksums. Nothing was installed.
error.update_bad_signature: The release is not signed by a trusted key. Nothing was installed.
error.update_container: Running in a container. Update the image, not the binary.
error.update_failed: Update not completed. Nothing was replaced.
error.update_offline: Outbound connections are disabled. Update check skipped.
error.update_too_old: That release is older than this database schema.
error.update_unverifiable: This build has no release keys and cannot verify updates.
error.update_wont_run: The downloaded binary does not run on this machine. Nothing was installed.
error.username_chars: Usernames cannot contain < > " ' & or control characters.
error.voting_closed: Voting is closed on this idea.
form.bodyPlaceholder: What happened and what was expected
form.emailHelp: Only used to notify you of changes.
form.kindBugHelp: Something that does not work as it should.
form.kindIdeaHelp: Something new, or a change to something that already exists.
form.lead: No account required. Reports are reviewed before they are published.
form.similarHelp: Vote for an existing report instead of creating a duplicate.
form.similarClosedHelp: A closed report says what the team decided and takes no more votes. Read it before asking again.
form.stepsHelp: The steps that lead to the problem.
form.stepsPlaceholder:
1. Open the board
2. Search for a word with an accent
3. Nothing comes back
form.title: Title
item.commentHint: Comments are reviewed before they appear.
item.commentWaiting: Sent. It will appear after review.
item.commentsClosed: This report is closed, so it takes no more comments.
item.commentsUntil: This report is closed. You can still write here until {date}, and then the conversation closes.
item.addWordHelp: Added to the server's word list when you reject it or mark it as spam.
item.confirmDelete: Delete “{title}”? Its votes, comments and replies will be deleted. This cannot be undone.
item.confirmDeleteComment: Delete this comment? This cannot be undone.
item.issueAttachHelp: Existing forge issue, by number or URL.
item.issueCreateHelp: Creates an issue on the organization's forge with this report's content and a link back to it.
item.issueLinkedHelp: Closing the issue on the forge closes this report, if the forge webhook is configured.
item.mergeNone: No other reports in this project.
item.replyHelp: Published immediately, signed as the team.
item.statusHelp: Shown on the public board and the roadmap.
item.yoursHelp: Keep this link. It is the only way to return to this report.
landing.aboutBoards: Boards that accept reports, as cards or a list.
landing.aboutLinks: Buttons or links to a form, a board or a URL.
landing.aboutReports: Most voted, resolved, latest or planned reports.
landing.aboutSearch: Finds published reports as the visitor types.
landing.altHint: Required. Read aloud to people who cannot see the image.
landing.caption: Caption
landing.chooseSomething: Select a section or a module to edit it.
landing.confirmRestore: Replace the front page with the default one?
landing.lastSection: The page needs at least one section.
landing.layoutHint: With fewer columns, the modules move to the last one.
landing.name: Name
landing.needAlt: Add a description to the image to save.
landing.needLink: Each link needs a label and a destination to save.
landing.newSectionLead: Start from a ready-made section or an empty layout.
landing.notSaved: Changes not saved. Check the connection.
landing.pageDescriptionHint: One sentence for search engines and link previews.
landing.pageTitleHint: Shown in the browser tab and in link previews. If empty, the installation name is used.
landing.pointStatus: Every report shows where it stands, from new to completed.
landing.readyAbout.heading: Name, tagline and search.
landing.ready.heading: Heading
landing.restoreHint: Replaces the front page with the default one. Ctrl+Z undoes it.
landing.shareImageHint: Shown in link previews. Recommended size: 1200 × 630.
landing.shareImageNoURL: Not shown in link previews until LASTHELP_PUBLIC_URL is set.
landing.subtitle: Tagline
landing.title: Title
landing.tooManyModules: The page has the maximum of 24 modules.
landing.tooManySections: The page has the maximum of 12 sections.
landing.writeOnPage: Edit the text directly on the page.
notify.testBody: This is a test from {name}. If you can read it, this channel works.
org.confirmRemove: Remove {name} from the {organization} team? The account is kept.
org.deleteHelp: Deletes its projects, reports, votes and replies. This cannot be undone.
org.editLead: A lead manages the whole organization. A collaborator triages the projects ticked. With none ticked, they leave the team.
org.forgeLead: The token is kept on this server and never shown again. Requires read and write access to issues.
org.noForgeLead: No forge connected. Reports are kept in this installation only.
org.notConnectedHelp: No token stored. Issues cannot be created until one is saved.
org.teamLead: Leads manage {organization}. Collaborators triage the projects they are given.
org.tokenWhere: In that forge: {where}, with the scope {scope}.
organizations.confirmDelete: Delete {name}? Its projects, reports, votes and replies will be deleted. This cannot be undone.
organizations.confirmDeleteRepo: Delete {name}? Its reports, votes and replies will be deleted. This cannot be undone.
organizations.lead: An organization groups projects and can connect to a forge.
overview.needsFailedWhy: The server gave up after trying again
overview.needsPush: Turn on notifications on this device
overview.needsPushWhy: Your team is told through Push, and nobody hears anything until each person turns it on
overview.noRoles: No roles assigned. An administrator can grant them.
notifications.lead: A channel every project can choose in its own settings. A project made after it is set starts on it; the ones that already exist are not affected.
antiabuse.lead: Words that turn a report down before it reaches your queue. One list for the whole server, in any language.
antiabuse.confirmRemove: “{word}” comes off the list, and its count goes with it.
antiabuse.wordsHelp: Capitals and accents do not matter. A word is matched whole, except in Chinese, Japanese, Korean and Thai, which have no spaces and are matched anywhere in a sentence. Up to {max} words of {length} characters.
antiabuse.noWords: No words yet. Add the ones that turn up in your own queue.
antiabuse.layersLead: How many submissions each check turned away, by project. A layer that never refuses anything is one to delete; one that refuses nearly everything is turning away people who did nothing wrong, and they do not complain, they leave.
antiabuse.layer.form_token: Form token missing, used or expired
antiabuse.layer.breaker: Project paused after too many in an hour
panel.addressHelp: Lowercase letters, digits and dashes. Used in the URL and cannot be changed later.
panel.channelHelp: Channel used to notify the team of new reports.
panel.channelPushNote: It goes to the browsers of whoever on the team turned it on under Notifications. Nobody is told until someone does.
panel.channelServerSet: This project tells the team through the channel its administrator set for the server.
panel.channelServerUnset: The administrator has not set the server's channel yet, so nothing will be sent until they do.
panel.channelTestSent: Test sent. If it did not arrive, check the channel's own app.
panel.firstStep: No organizations yet. Add one to get started.
panel.forgeHelp: Where issues are opened, such as GitHub, GitLab or Gitea. Optional.
panel.forgeOwnerHelp: The account or organization that owns the repositories, as spelled in the forge.
panel.forgeRepoHelp: The repository name only. The owner comes from the organization.
panel.forgeURLHelp: The base address of the forge, with no path.
panel.issueQueued: Queued. The issue will be created shortly.
panel.mergeHelp: Votes are transferred without double counting.
panel.name: Name
panel.nameHelp: Shown to visitors. Can be changed later.
panel.rewriteHelp: Edits the published text. Type and status are not changed.
panel.secretHelp: The same secret configured in the forge, used to verify deliveries.
panel.tokenHelp: Kept on this server, never shown again. Needs read and write access to issues.
panel.tokenSaved: A token is saved and is not shown. Type a new one to replace it, or empty the field to remove it.
panel.webhookPathHelp: Add this URL to the forge's webhook settings. Required to close reports when their issues close.
people.addHelp: New accounts have no access until a role is assigned.
people.confirmDelete: Delete the account {name}? Their reports and replies are kept.
people.editHelp: Leave empty to keep the current value.
people.languageHelp: Panel language for this account. It can be changed later.
people.lead: Accounts are created by an administrator. There is no public sign-up.
people.roleHelp: A lead manages an organization. A collaborator triages one project.
people.rolesHelp: A role applies to one organization or one project.
personalization.accentHelp: Applies to buttons, links and highlights.
personalization.lead: The name, logo and accent color shown to everyone.
pictures.confirmRemove: Remove this image? This cannot be undone.
pictures.hint: Up to {count}. You can also paste or drop them here.
pictures.privacy: Check that your screenshots show no passwords or private details.
pictures.someFailed: Some images could not be added: {reason}
portal.empty: Nothing has been set up yet.
profile.passwordHelp: Changing it signs out all other sessions of this account.
profile.usernameHelp: Used to sign in, and shown beside your replies.
push.title: Notifications on your devices
push.lead: Be told when a report arrives on a board that uses Push, even with LastHelp closed. The message goes through your browser's push service (Google, Apple, Mozilla or Microsoft), which can tell that a device was notified and when, but not what it said.
push.thisDeviceHelp: Turn notifications on in this browser.
push.testSent: Test sent. It should reach your devices in a moment.
push.denied: Notifications are blocked for this site. Allow them in your browser's settings and come back.
push.needsInstall: On an iPhone or iPad, add LastHelp to the Home Screen and open it from there to turn notifications on.
push.unsupported: This browser cannot receive push notifications.
push.permissionDenied: Notifications were not allowed, so this device was not turned on.
repo.acceptsHelp: At least one. Can be changed later.
repo.acceptsImages: Images from reporters and the team
repo.askVersionHelp: The problem form asks which version was in use. For software.
repo.askStepsHelp: The problem form asks for the steps that lead to the problem.
repo.questionsLead: Your own questions, asked beside the title and the description. Up to 10.
repo.noQuestions: No questions of your own yet.
question.label: Question
question.labelHelp: As the person reporting will read it.
question.typeFixed: The kind of answer stays as it was chosen: answers already given were given to it.
question.requiredHelp: A report cannot be sent without an answer.
question.confirmRemove: Remove “{label}” from the form? Answers already given stay on their reports.
repo.acceptsLead: Report types accepted in this project.
repo.confirmRevoke: Remove {name} from this project? The account is kept.
repo.imagesHelp: They wait for the team's review with their report, and are erased 30 days after it closes.
visibility.private: Only the team can see it
visibility.help: Everyone else gets a page that does not exist: it is not listed, not searched, has no feed and its links stop working. You can switch it back at any time.
visibility.orgHelp: Every board under it is hidden too. Everyone else gets a page that does not exist. You can switch it back at any time.
repo.deleteHelp: Deletes its reports, votes and replies. This cannot be undone.
repo.exportHelp: All reports as JSON, including pending and rejected.
icon.label: Icon
icon.help: Shown beside its name on the public pages.
repo.lead: Each project has its own report board. With a forge connected, issues are created only on request.
repo.noCollaborators: No collaborators. Organization leads also have access.
repo.reportsHelp: All reports, current and past: read, edit, answer or delete.
repo.teamLead: Leads of {organization} have access to all its projects. Collaborators have access to this one.
review.pickOne: Select an item from the list.
review.title: Reports
roadmap.declinedHelp: The team's reply on each report says why.
roadmap.lead: Generated from the state of each report.
roadmap.quietBody: When an idea is planned or a problem is confirmed it shows up on this page, and what is delivered stacks up by month. Nobody updates it by hand.
roadmap.quietTitle: What the team decides to do will appear here.
sent.keepLink: Keep this link. It is the only way back to your report and is not shown again.
sent.title: Sent
sessions.title: Active sessions
sessions.lead: Every browser this account is signed in on. If you do not recognize one, close it and change your password.
sessions.closeOthersConfirm: Every other browser or device signed in to this account will be signed out. This one stays signed in.
sessions.closeOneConfirm: Sign {device} out of this account? It can sign in again with the password.
twoStep.title: Two-step sign-in
twoStep.enterCode: Enter the code from your authenticator app.
twoStep.enterRecovery: Enter one of your recovery codes.
twoStep.offHint: Ask for a code from an authenticator app after your password.
twoStep.scan: Scan this code with your authenticator app, or type the key in by hand.
twoStep.confirmCode: Then enter the 6-digit code the app shows
twoStep.recoveryLow: Generate new ones before you run out.
twoStep.newCodesMessage: Enter your password to get new recovery codes. The old ones will stop working.
twoStep.turnOffMessage: Enter your password to turn off two-step sign-in.
twoStep.codesWarning: Recovery codes are shown only now, and each one works once. Keep them somewhere safe.
twoStep.adminRemoveHint: For somebody who lost their phone and their recovery codes.
twoStep.adminRemoveConfirm: Remove two-step sign-in from {name}? They will sign in with the password alone until they turn it on again.
passkey.title: Passkeys
passkey.hint: Sign in with your fingerprint, face or screen lock instead of your password.
passkey.removeConfirm: Remove the passkey {name}? You will no longer be able to sign in with it.
passkey.needHttps: Passkeys need this page to be opened over https with its name (not an IP address).
passkey.deviceHasOne: This device already has a passkey for this account.
setup.doneLead: The administrator account and the installation name are set.
setup.doneNext: Next, create an organization to group your projects.
setup.instanceNameHelp: Shown in the header and the browser tab. Leave empty to use LastHelp.
setup.orgLead: An organization groups projects. It can also connect to a forge such as GitHub, GitLab or Gitea.
update.channelHelp: Beta releases arrive earlier and may be unstable.
update.intro: The release is downloaded, verified and installed, and the service restarts by itself.
update.restartTimeout: The new version didn't respond in time. Check the server logs — it may still be starting.
update.restarting: Installed. Waiting for the new version to come back up…
update.runningHint: Don't close this window or stop the server until it finishes.
update.sessionExpired: Your session is no longer valid, so the server refused to start the update. Reload the page, sign in again and retry.
notify.updateBody: This server runs {current}. Open About to see what is new and to update.
notifications.updatesHelp: Tell the administrators through this channel when a newer version of LastHelp is out, once for each version.
